description: Janana De Malucho Textile Mills Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 6 October 1960 and began commercial production at Kohat in 1963 as a composite unit with spinning, weaving and processing; its weaving and processing units closed in 1983 and the company now spins yarn. It produces super-fine 80s and 100s combed and carded yarns from extra-long staple cotton of USA Pima and CIS origin, and 40/s and 60/s combed yarn for air-jet looms. Capacity is 64,704 spindles and 600 rotors, and the mill is at Habibabad, Kohat, about 53 km south of Peshawar.
ceo: Lt. Gen. (Retd.) Ali Kuli Khan Khattak
